title: Many samples, a folder or a whole library export into one browsable folder without collisions
description:
As a beatmaker with a big library, I want many samples exported into one folder in one go, each in its own sample folder, so that the whole library's markup is browsable in the DAW without collisions.

```gherkin
Feature: Many samples in one browsable folder
  Scenario: A folder exports every analyzed sample under it
    Given the folder "marches" holds the analyzed samples "a.wav" and "b.wav" and the unanalyzed audio "c.wav"
    When I export the clips of "marches" to "out"
    Then the folders "out/a" and "out/b" are written
    And it says "marches/c.wav is not analyzed; skipped"

  Scenario: Two samples with the same file name do not collide
    Given the analyzed samples "x/take.wav" and "y/take.wav"
    When I export the clips of "x" and "y" to "out"
    Then the folders "out/x-take" and "out/y-take" are written

  Scenario: Samples from a library are exported by their catalog path
    Given a library holding "marine-band/Thunderer.mp3" with its automatic markup
    When I export the clips of "marine-band/Thunderer.mp3" to "out" with "--library" pointing at the library
    Then the folder "out/Thunderer" is written
    And every clip file in it references the library's audio file for that sample

  Scenario: A whole library
    Given a library holding three analyzed samples
    When I export the clips of the whole library to "out" with "--library" pointing at the library
    Then "out" holds one folder per sample that has automatic markup

  Scenario: Kind folders only appear when they hold something
    Given the analyzed sample "drums.wav" with loops and one-shots but no sections
    When I export the clips of "drums.wav" to "out"
    Then "out/drums" holds the folders "loops" and "shots" and no "sections"
```
